rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger); the frame path is now the only place that sizes the swapchain and the Graphite targets. GpuSurface::resize() (gpu_surface_dawn.cpp) only records the requested size; begin_frame() configures at most once, before each acquire, when the size changed, and the SuccessSuboptimal re-acquire goes through the same check. A zero dimension skips the frame and configures nothing. SkiaSurface::resize() (skia_surface.cpp) likewise only records the size: begin_frame() reallocates the offscreen and persistent-scene targets, and drops the retained layers on a scale change, once per frame; a presentable surface no longer allocates the offscreen target it never draws into. gpu_surface.hpp gains the header-only SwapchainResizeState (including a two-frame settled state) and a tail-of-vtable swapchain_stats(); skia_surface.hpp gains a tail-of-vtable render_target_allocations() counter. No present, readback-format, design-import, Chromium, packaging or authority boundary moves; the Pulp render target has not adopted a Vellum package.
